section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1968
title: ## ALL-INDIA SURVEY During the year 1968, 40,688 suicides were reported in the entire country as against 38,386 during 1967 indicating an increase of 6·0%. Table 6 presents the comparative incidence of suicides during the last five years. It may be observed that the incidence of suicides increased by 21·0% during the last five years as against a 10·2% increase in the population, indicating thereby that the rate of growth of suicides is practically double the rate of growth of the population.
